PHASE.NAME: Post-Roadmap Debt Closure
PHASE.GOAL: Close the release-blocking and release-quality debts left after the professional GRACE roadmap: strict-ready traceability, belief-state baseline coverage, legacy LINKS migration pressure, non-human advisory warnings, and large-file maintainability risk.

DEBT_BASELINE.ITEM: Traceability is advisory; self-report shows low score because old function contracts lack direct requirement/use-case links.
Belief-state mechanism exists, but current project coverage is near zero.
Legacy comma/path LINKS are still accepted and reported as migration debt.
Strict non-human pattern scan has advisory magic-value warnings.
Several mature modules exceed the 500-line maintainability target while staying below the hard 1300-line gate.

step-1.TITLE: Strict-Ready Traceability Defaults
step-1.INTENT: Reduce traceability gaps without hand-editing hundreds of function contracts by allowing functions to inherit explicit module/product intent where the module is mapped to a known requirement or use case.
step-1.IMPLEMENTATION: Add deterministic module intent defaults for Synapse module families, propagate module business trace links to contained functions, keep direct function LINKS authoritative, and cover strict-mode inheritance with tests.
step-1.VERIFY: traceability-index now runs strict and remains compact at 91 lines, all 85 modules have product intent defaults, requirements are traced 3/3, traceability score is 99.1%, and no dangling traceability links are reported.

step-2.TITLE: Belief-State Baseline Coverage
step-2.INTENT: Create persisted docs/belief-states artifacts for current modules so the project has an observable AI belief baseline before release.
step-2.IMPLEMENTATION: Generate/refine BELIEF_STATE artifacts from module shards or source contracts, preserving valid INPUT/PROCESSING/OUTPUT flows, invariants, strategy, verification intent, and risks.
step-2.VERIFY: Generated 85 persisted docs/belief-states/M-*.xml artifacts through extract_belief_state; belief-state-exists reports full 85/85 module coverage.

step-3.TITLE: Advisory Warning Reduction
step-3.INTENT: Reduce migration noise before public release without destabilizing legacy compatibility.
step-3.IMPLEMENTATION: Migrate high-value legacy LINKS to directional typed LINKS, suppress false-positive rendering/template noise, and replace remaining high-signal magic values with named constants/messages where they improve clarity.
step-3.VERIFY: Semantic legacy LINKS warnings are reduced to zero; strict non-human pattern review reports score=100.0%, errors=0, warnings=0; verify/review remain green.

step-4.TITLE: Maintainability Split Plan
step-4.INTENT: Keep large modules from becoming future release blockers.
step-4.IMPLEMENTATION: Document safe split boundaries for dashboard, traceability, cascade, contract, verify, and MCP helper files; implement only low-risk splits that do not churn public APIs before release.
step-4.VERIFY: docs/maintainability-split-plan.xml records safe split boundaries and accepts the 500-line warnings for the release candidate while the 1300-line hard gate passes.

RESUME_POINTER.NEXT_ACTION: Phase-14 complete. Next read plan-index.xml, then run release readiness review or prepare release candidate.
